sloka: यद्यधर्मो भवेद्भूतो रावणो नरकं व्रजेत्।भवांश्च धर्मयुक्तो वै नैवं व्यसनमाप्नुयात् ।। ६.८३.१७ ।।
transliteration: yadyadharmo bhavedbhūto rāvaṇo narakaṁ vrajet।bhavāṁśca dharmayukto vai naivaṁ vyasanamāpnuyāt ।। 6.83.17 ।।

translations.english: "If there is unrighteousness, Ravana should be in hell. You who are endowed with righteousness should not have agony."
